grounding.states: Sienna is the only minivan offered only as a hybrid, 35-36 mpg combined

It has a standard hybrid powertrain and available all-wheel drive
MSRP is $41,320 to $58,710, with 35–36 mpg combined

grounding.states: Honda Odyssey is top with U.S. News and drives most like a car
grounding.from: U.S. News names the 2026 Honda Odyssey the best minivan, with an overall score of 9.3/10; It drives the most like a car, with responsive steering and a smooth V6

value.answer: In the US I'd go with the Toyota Sienna. Edmunds, Quartz and AutoGuide all put it first, it's hybrid-only with 35-36 mpg combined, and you can get all-wheel drive. It runs $41,320 to $58,710. The Honda Odyssey is the one to get if you care most about how it drives, since U.S. News has it at the top and it feels the most like a car.
